fruit.term: as far as we can verify

propaganda.term: they don't want you to know

characterizations.name: Coherent Storyteller
characterizations.output: Coherent narrative structure. Low evidence grounding. No falsifiable predictions offered.

characterizations.name: Grounded Truth-Teller
characterizations.output: Well-grounded in evidence. Virtuous framing. Minimal propaganda markers.

characterizations.name: Sophisticated Propagandist
characterizations.output: High internal consistency with structural deception patterns. Persuasive but ungrounded.

characterizations.name: Academic Gatekeeper
characterizations.output: Dense jargon obscuring weak substance. Pharisee Function active.

characterizations.name: Fear Merchant
characterizations.output: Heavy control/threat language with propaganda markers. Minimal virtuous framing.

characterizations.name: Prophet Without Kill Conditions
characterizations.output: Unverifiable future claims. No stated conditions for being wrong. Prophecy without accountability.

characterizations.name: Balanced Analyst
characterizations.output: Evidence-based with acknowledged tensions. Healthy contradiction markers suggest intellectual honesty.

characterizations.name: Woke Ideologue
characterizations.output: Ideology-heavy language from institutional equity/identity framework. Jargon-dense.

characterizations.name: Fitts-Pattern Analyst
characterizations.output: Control grid vocabulary with some evidence grounding. Verify cited sources independently.

characterizations.name: Pure Fruit
characterizations.output: Heavily virtuous language. Beautiful — but check for substance beneath the language.
